name: com.crisp.lit
description: A drop-in replacement for URP's Lit shader with a full-quality BRDF: height-correlated Smith visibility, real Schlick Fresnel, multiscatter energy compensation, Disney diffuse, specular occlusion and geometric specular anti-aliasing. Uses URP's own lighting API and keyword set, so shadows, Forward+, decals, SSAO, lightmaps and probe volumes keep working.
